jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, Organizational Change Management
jobs.description:
Intuit's CTREC organization (Cybersecurity, Trust & Safety, Risk, Enterprise Systems and Compliance) protects the company and powers the technology experiences of our global workforce. We're looking for a Senior Change Manager to own organizational change management (OCM) delivery and adoption strategy for CTREC's most critical programs — the changes that touch every Intuit employee, from security protocols to enterprise systems to employee-experience technology.
This is a hands-on leadership role, not an advisory one. You will craft the change strategy for each program and personally execute every piece of it — communications across channels, enablement content, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement. There is no separate design or communications team behind you, and no runway to learn the discipline on the job. Skilled, self-directed OCM leadership is essential to adoption success from day one.
You'll operate as part of the Change COE — the team that designs the human layer around technology change so employees don't just get access to something new; they understand it, want it, and can use it well. The COE matches its response to the size and risk of each change: it Drives the highest-impact changes end to end, Supports moderate ones by contributing strategy while the owning team executes, and Consults as the fast expert check on lower-risk changes. You'll flex across all three modes and partner with the OCM lead to define the engagement model and tiered level of support for each initiative.

Intuit has embraced a hybrid working model and this role will be based in office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end OCM delivery and adoption strategy for critical CTREC programs — from impact assessment through launch, adoption, and reinforcement.
- Build change strategy from scratch and execute it end to end yourself: audience and impact analysis, adoption plans, success metrics, and risk mitigation — with no reliance on separate design or communications resources.
- Develop and deliver communications for multiple channels (email, Slack, intranet, in-tool messaging, executive briefings), right-sized to audience and moment.
- Create enablement content — guides, FAQs, training assets, self-service resources — that helps a distributed global workforce understand, embrace, and adopt change.
- Drive stakeholder engagement across all levels, from frontline employees to senior leadership, building the coalitions each change needs to land.

- Invent creative, low-friction adoption solutions — resourceful ways to reach and activate distributed audiences and build trust in automation that acts on a user's behalf.
- Develop and implement change management tools and processes that accelerate change activities, ensure a consistent change experience, and standardize communication approaches across programs.
- Monitor employee feedback channels to address questions and gauge sentiment on Security change initiatives, feeding insights back into program decisions.
- Measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate — closing the loop between user sentiment and program decisions.

Qualifications

- Proven ability to own change strategy from scratch and execute it end to end personally — you are the strategist, writer, designer, and facilitator in one.
- A track record of creative, low-friction adoption solutions that reached and activated distributed audiences — including building user trust in automation acting on their behalf.
- AI platform fluency — you use AI tools and platforms fluently in your own work (research, content development, analysis) and can guide others through AI-driven change.
- Excellent writing and content-design skills across formats and channels, with the judgment to right-size comms to the change.

- Self-direction and speed: you scope ambiguity into a plan, prioritize independently, and deliver without needing the role explained to you.

- Proven ability to manage concurrent workloads under a fixed deadline, sequencing communications across phased waves to prevent audience fatigue and message conflicts.

- Domain experience across collaboration SaaS applications, HR, and Security, with a working understanding of data security and compliance concepts.

Who You Are

jobs.title: Principal, Strategy & Business Operations
jobs.description:
About Intuit
Intuit is a mission-driven, global financial platform company that gives everyone the opportunity to prosper. We do this by using technology to solve our customers' most important problems: putting more money in their pockets, eliminating unnecessary work and complexity, and helping them make financial decisions with confidence. Our flagship products, QuickBooks, TurboTax, and Credit Karma, reflect our commitment to transforming how people manage their finances, run small businesses, and pay employees. Intuit is a trusted partner to millions of small businesses and consumers, with a presence that is both broad and deeply rooted.

Who We Serve
Small businesses are the engine of the economy. In the U.S. they employ 60% of the workforce and create 80% of new jobs, yet most face long odds. QuickBooks exists to change those odds, giving small businesses the tools and confidence to manage their money, run their operations, and grow. It is Intuit's largest, most established business, and one of its fastest moving.

About the Role
Business Strategy and Operations (Biz Ops) exists to help define where we're going and help our teams focus on and execute against the most important work for QuickBooks. We do that in several ways: (1) shaping the strategy and vision for where we are going and what we want to achieve, (2) driving the rigor behind how we plan, (3) quarterbacking the highest impact work streams that cut across segments and functions, (4) building the operating systems that hold us accountable to what we said we would do, and (5) finding the next big bets before anyone else does.

We are hiring a Principal who can operate as both a senior strategic advisor and a hands-on builder: someone who can identify where QuickBooks should go next, shape that point of view with senior leadership, and personally drive the work that turns it into durable growth. This is an individual contributor role reporting directly to the Director of Strategy & Business Operations, QuickBooks Small Business and Platform, with the scope and visibility of someone operating at the center of the business: serving as a critical partner to our VPs of Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Customer Success & Delivery, and becoming the person senior leaders come to for advice, fast clarity, and an unvarnished read on where things really stand.

This is a role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just coordinate work. You will structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and personally engage in the most complex and high-impact work, whether that means uncovering the next growth vector before anyone else sees it, figuring out where AI can meaningfully change how QuickBooks serves small businesses, or building the operating system that turns a bold idea into a shipped outcome.

About Intuit
Intuit believes in the power of the individual. The power to do more. To make more. To be more.
We believe in the people who do things – the hat jugglers, the to-do list gurus, those who love getting it done faster, better, and more efficiently than ever before. Whether that's balancing the household budget, running a business, or paying taxes.
We believe in these people because we are these people. We thrive on action – and results. And by making things simpler, we all get more out of doing what we love. We're innovators and have been at it for more than three decades. And we don't stand still.
As the world evolves, so do we – inventing new solutions to solve important problems, perfecting those solutions, and delighting our customers. In short: We’re on a mission to power prosperity around the world.
We started small in 1983 with Quicken personal finance software, simplifying a common household dilemma: balancing the family checkbook. Today, Intuit is a leading provider of fintech solutions for consumers, SMBs, and the self-employed. You probably know us by our flagship products, TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp which serve over 100 million consumers and 20 million small businesses and self-employed across North America, Europe, Australia, and around the world.
